summary: The candidate adds dynamic app and plugin inventories served as XML and JSON from the apex router, reusing the cached health snapshot. It validates public metadata, escapes XML text, handles GET, HEAD, OPTIONS and invalid configuration, and includes focused tests. No introduced correctness defects were found.

evidence: `src/sitemap-generator.ts` adds `handleSitemap`, which serves `/sitemap.xml`, `/sitemap.json`, `/plugin-map.xml` and `/plugin-map.json` with XML and JSON bodies.
`src/plugin-map-discovery.ts` compiles app and plugin entries and aggregate statuses from the cached `HealthSnapshot` check results.
`src/worker.ts` wires the map endpoints on `ubq.fi` and builds the app inventory from `APP_WORKERS`, `VPS_ORIGIN_MAP` and the health dashboard.
`tests/sitemap.test.ts` covers discovery, aggregation, XML escaping, routing, shared caching and configuration validation.
